description_for_human: Discover agents, inspect service readiness, and fetch GhostGate pricing and x402 metadata.
description_for_model: Use this plugin to read Ghost Protocol agent and pricing metadata. Query /api/agents to list agents and /api/pricing for authoritative GhostGate Express pricing and canonical x402 metadata. Gate execution itself requires signed EIP-712 auth headers; open x402 runs directly against merchant endpoints.
